item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator instruction (authenticated, local socket): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix.

Constraints: do not modify test files. Fix the root cause in window.py, correct for all inputs (edge cases such as empty input, boundaries, and off-by-one ranges included). Keep functions under 60 lines and follow existing style. Verify by running `python3 -m unittest` and confirm all tests pass. Commit the fix with a clear message; the commit author must be the repository's configured git user, with no tool or AI attribution lines.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

pr.body: Approach: window count is len(items) - size + 1; the empty range for size > len is correct. Key file: window.py (one line). Tests unchanged. Checks: python3 -m unittest passes 3/3 (was 2 failures). Edge cases verified directly: empty input, size equal to len, size greater than len, size 1, size <= 0 still raises ValueError. Assumptions: none beyond the existing ValueError contract.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return every window. Now includes the final window. Before: range(len(items) - size) dropped the last window, now: range(len(items) - size + 1).
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window
